description: Unit test class for CreateThing command in the Eclipse Ditto project, verifying creation, JSON serialization, equality, and exception handling.

classes.name: CreateThingTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CreateThing, verifying various behaviors such as immutability, equality, JSON conversion, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that CreateThing instances and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThing
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to CreateThing.of() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithValidThingId
methods.description: Tests creation of CreateThing from a valid Thing object with a specific ID.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson() method returns the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creation of CreateThing object from JSON string.

methods.name: createTooLargeThing
methods.description: Checks that a Thing exceeding size limits throws ThingTooLargeException.

methods.name: initializeWithCopiedPolicy
methods.description: Tests initialization with a copied policy reference.

methods.name: initializeWithCopiedPolicyAndWithInitialPolicyNullAndPolicyIdNullString
methods.description: Tests initialization with null policies and a policy ID string.

methods.name: initializeWithCopiedPolicyAndWithInitialPolicyNullAndPolicyIdNull
methods.description: Tests initialization with null policies and a null PolicyId object.

methods.name: initializeWithCopiedPolicyAndWithInitialPolicy
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown if initial policy is provided when copying from a policy reference.

methods.name: parseCreateThingCommand
methods.description: Verifies parsing of CreateThing command from JSON via the command registry.
